identity.name: BalancedPrep
identity.core_value: Peace of mind in the kitchen. No fitness-bro energy.

headings.usage: Use for all page titles, section headers, and day names. Tracking tight (-0.02em).

body.usage: Use for all standard text, inputs, and list items. Relaxed line-height.

typography.instructions: Import fonts from Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Outfit:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

usage_rules: NEVER use pure black (#000000). Use the warm charcoal defined in --foreground.
Primary color (Sage Green) is for 'Success' and 'Action'. Do not overuse it.
Background is NOT white. It is a very pale warm stone (#FAFAF9). Cards are white.
Use 'Accent' (Pale Yellow/Cream) for highlighting active days or tips.

layout.spacing_system: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for main containers. Gap-6 for grids.

grid_strategy.dashboard: Bento Grid. 7 Days. Current day is col-span-2 or featured. Other days are smaller cards.
grid_strategy.grocery_list: Single column, wide cards with checkbox on left.
grid_strategy.mobile: Stack everything. Use bottom sheet (Drawer) for details.

layout.radius: rounded-2xl (16px) for cards, rounded-full for buttons.

cards.style: Flat white background, 1px border-stone-200. No shadow by default.
cards.hover: shadow-md border-primary/30 transition-all duration-300 ease-out translate-y-[-2px]

buttons.primary: rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-lg font-medium shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all

inputs.style: bg-white border-stone-200 h-12 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary

navigation.style: Bottom fixed bar on mobile (glassmorphism). Top simple nav on desktop.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 for sticky headers and toast notifications.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a very subtle noise texture to the main background if possible, or keep it clean flat stone.
visual_enhancers.icons: Lucide React. Use stroke-width={1.5} for a refined look. Color: text-stone-600.

motion.hover_effects: Scale 1.02 for cards. Brightness 1.1 for buttons.

landing_hero.alt: Healthy meal prep on wooden table
landing_hero.usage: Hero section background or side image

grocery_context.alt: Paper grocery bag with fresh vegetables
grocery_context.usage: Empty state for grocery list or header for grocery section

meal_detail_placeholder.usage: Default image for recipes without photos

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. UPDATE /app/frontend/src/index.css with the CSS variables provided in 'colors.variables.light'. Remove the old ones.
3. CREATE a 'Layout' component that enforces the max-width and padding.
5. ENSURE all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
6. DO NOT use gradients for backgrounds. Keep it flat and clean.
7. For the 'Meal Prep Level' slider, use a custom styled slider that looks like a volume knob or a simple track with steps.
8. The 'Grocery List' should feel like a paper checklist. Use a serif font for the list items if possible, or just clean sans.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
